note: The scripted bot's keyword rules, in order: the first rule with a keyword in the message wins, else the fallback card. The intent bot's cards are one fixed reply per Labelling intent. Hand-written for the site.

rules.reply: You can track your order from the link in your confirmation email.
Refunds go back to the card you paid with once we receive the item.
You can return unused items. Print a returns label from your account.
Choose Click and Collect at checkout and we will email you when it is ready.
Use Forgot password on the sign-in page to reset it.

fallback: Sorry, I didn't understand. Please choose an option from the menu or call us.

intentReplies.refund: We have sent your message to our refunds team. They will reply by email.
intentReplies.return: Our returns team will email you a returns label.
intentReplies.delivery: Our delivery team will check on your order and email you an update.
intentReplies.product: Our product experts will answer your question by email.
intentReplies.account: Our accounts team will help you get back into your account.

intentFallback: Sorry, I'm not sure what you need. A member of staff will reply when the desk opens.
